CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reagents_dedup AS
WITH cas_base AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        name,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        '' as notes,
        MIN(lot_id) as primary_lot_id
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
)
SELECT 
    cb.cas_number,
    cb.name,
    cb.total_quantity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.location, ', ') as location,
    cb.notes,
    cb.primary_lot_id
FROM cas_base cb
JOIN reagents r ON cb.cas_number = r.cas_number
GROUP BY cb.cas_number, cb.name, cb.total_quantity, cb.notes, cb.primary_lot_id
ORDER BY cb.cas_number;
SELECT * FROM reagents_dedup ORDER BY cas_number;
